body: I found it difficult to use. I want a brief "calm down" practice, not a 30 minute story, but couldn't figure out how to get that. But most significantly, if I am paying for a subscription, there should be no ads or pop-ups. (If there are ads, the app should be free.) I refuse to both pay a high subscription cost for a phone app AND get inundated with ads. Will be canceling the free trial (hopefully it will really cancel 🤞) and will uninstall.
developer_reply: We're sorry to hear about the frustrating experience, and we appreciate you for bringing this to our attention. Please send an email to support@calm.com, and we'll be happy to look into the ads that appear on your account, as well as helping you navigate the app.

body: To the UI development team: STOP CHANGING THINGS AROUND!! For an updated review: Still using Calm 6 years later. I love the sleep stories & the music options are nice, too. I wish they would be more consistent with some of their options. Some of the sleep story soundtracks are available as an independent listen, some are not. Some stories have more than one episode, other stories don't continue. They have a nice selection of classics, but only the first two chapters.

I downloaded & signed up for a trial. I attempted to do a meditation & I didn't like how the ambient nature sounds had what sounded like a crowd behind it. I shut it off & tried to close the meditation, but it wouldn't let me close just pause. It kept restarting on its own. I cleared the app cache & it still did it. I uninstalled the app & reinstalled and this exercise was still there. I canceled the trial & deleted the app. Calm sent me a push notification to my phone today as a deleted app.
developer_reply: So sorry you had this frustrating experience. We understand how concerning it must have been. Thank you for taking the time to explain what happened. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please reach out to support@calm.com who would be happy to help you make it right.

body: While I like it to remind me to relax, it is sloooooooow. It takes forever to load initially and as you switch between the screens it takes even longer to load. I have to constantly close out of the app and go back in just to get the main page to load. When I'm frustrated, stressed or overwhelmed, have the app take so long to load to get to the exercises is NOT helpful. It defeats the purpose.

I have been meditating for years and I was excited when my employer included this as a benefit. That excitement ended quickly once I started using the app. It's a very busy app and feels very Sesame Street to me. I was having trouble sleeping and I remembered that I could use this app for free. I wanted to see what teachers they used w/o success. I clicked on 1 that sounded like an AI voice (ugh). If you are new to meditation, this is great. If you aren't, go elsewhere. (Insight timer)
developer_reply: Thank you for providing your valuable feedback! We're sorry to hear that you didn't enjoy your experience. Feel free to send us a note at help@headspace.com. We will be happy to help with content recommendations and changing teachers.

body: Update: un-installed, reinstalled. Now my track will play for about 2 minutes, then cuts out. It says it's still playing, but no sound. If I force close/reopen, can't open the track to play it. Currently not working on my galaxy s21 ultra. I can get the app to open and navigate to sleep, but I can't get any of the tracks to open. If I click on brown or orange noise, or the deep sleep binaural beat I usually use, it just hangs on a lack screen forever!
developer_reply: Thank you for reaching out regarding this. We deeply apologize for the inconvenience and want to help investigate the issue. Please reach out with your information to our support team at help@headspace.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

body: Don't bother. There are only 10 sounds still available in the free version. I've loved this app for a long time but the reduction in features is ridiculous. I opened the app today and 90% of my mixes are now locked because sounds that used to be free are now paid. For some people, me included, $5 isn't nothing and I don't have extra to throw at a formerly free app. I recommend finding another app - preferably one with more than a dozen sounds.
developer_reply: Hi Gianna, thank you for sharing your thoughts. We're really sorry for the frustration this has caused, especially after being a longtime user. We understand that every dollar counts, and it means a lot that you’ve stuck with us. Please message us in the app so we can offer you a free month of Premium and help make things a little easier. 🍀Jyn

body: I've had this app for years, since before the new name and rebrand. I was lucky to grab the lifetime membership for like $10 years ago, and I'm so glad I did. I love BetterSleep and use it almost every night. The variety and quality of sounds, music, stories, and meditations is unmatched. I only have two very minor qualms: 1. I wish there was an option to add your own music, even just a single track 2. Occasionally the app takes a few minutes to load my profile, but that could just be my phone
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your support over the years, Riley! We’re so happy to be part of your nightly routine. If Audio Focus is turned off, you can use BetterSleep alongside other audio apps. For the loading issue, please message us through the in-app Help section so we can take a closer look. We’re happy to help!🙏🏽Marou

body: This used to be a great app and I used it for years upon years. Now nearly everything is kept behind a paywall. You can't even use basic white noise without paying a monthly subscription. So incredibly frustrating that it has become basically non functional without paying. Im so disappointed that what seemed like such a genuine company gave in to greed. Very upsetting when i have used the same sounds to fall asleep for years, and now I will have to find a new routine.
developer_reply: Hi Jordan, we understand how upsetting this change feels after using the same sounds and routine for years. Last year, we made the difficult decision to move to a paid model. Some free content remains, but most of our library is now Premium. If price is a concern, please message us in the in-app Help section.🌿

body: I love that there are a lot of different stories and meditations to choose from. I like the background sound effects. I like that you can choose by narrator. The only downfall is the sleep tracking. It's a great idea, but it's so buggy. Once it showed I went back in time in my sleep. It also says my average bedtime is 4pm. Wish they would fix this because sleep tracking is important to me and I do use the app almost every night.

I have used Calm and Slumber to help me fall asleep. I like Slumber the best. But I often wake up when the sounds stop, so I add a couple episodes of whatever story I am listen to and then follow it up witha bunch of music (mostly binural) and this works great, but I have to set it up each and every night. If there were editable playlists that we can save it would be so much better. They say they are working on it. I hope they deliver soon! Calm has finally created playlists.

I find Slumber to be much more aligned to being put to sleep, unlike it's major 'competitor'. Being able to choose the type of audio each time helps me focus on what I need that night. Each narrator's choice is calm & soothing; you can even select your favorite. I had need of customer service, and was blown away by the speed of response & true concern for my need. Worth the subscription!!
developer_reply: Thanks for the glowing review, Louise! We do what we can 😄

body: I was charged 2 fees initally for 1 subscription. Contacted customer service to cancel, Was then told there were 3 remaining subscriptions!! HOW?!?! The app kept locking me out saying the free trial expired (before the 7 day trial ended) and ask for payment, but would later let me back in. Then it would lock out again asking for more money. Absolutely a money grab. Do NOT recommend.

App takes away from the science.. The app is difficult to navigate. The bottom menu is cut off because on android, for some reason it doesn't allow the bottom phone menu to disappear. Doesn't accommodate for work schedules. My recommended wake up time is 8-9am, but work starts at 6am. It still tells me my bed time should be 1030pm, but somehow I gave to get 9hrs of sleep. Overall, worth the trial however for tracking peaks and dips in energy and energy % for the day.
developer_reply: We sincerely apologize for the issue you experienced while using the Android version of our app. Currently, the Android app lags behind the iOS version in terms of features and capabilities, We are actively striving to make changes that will address your concerns and provide you with an improved user experience.

body: I think this would work well for people who have at least somewhat of a consistent schedule, but as a worker in the service industry, it's not flexible enough for me. The sleep need it chose for me felt pretty arbitrary, and it wanted me to start avoiding blue light while I was still at work. I also found the nightstand detection wasn't very accurate, which I don't think would've bothered me except I do have a watch that was linked, and I wish you could change it to recording your sleep there.
developer_reply: Thank you for taking the time to provide us with feedback. We are pleased to be of service to you and we would love to hear from you again. If you have any questions, comments, or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us via email at support@risescience.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

body: If the price were more reasonable I would give five stars. However I think the price is too high for the product it delivers. It definitely helped me when my insomnia was at its worst. Sleep restriction was especially effective. One thing I would improve is the soundscapes or like meditation things would often turn off mid-listen so I'd have to break out of my attempt to sleep to restart them which was frustrating. Overall I liked the app and would renew if my insomnia returned.

App does not disclose that it has no free features or am actual free trial. Once you spend all the time entering your info, it then offers a "free one week trial" that you can pay what you want. But there's no option for not paying. I don't pay a penny for apps I can't try first, and I don't pay for apps that say they are free when they aren't.

The app repeats, "You only need 5.5 hours of sleep per night to function!" As encouragement during sleep restriction. First of all, most people who are experiencing insomnia aren't worried about getting less than 8 hours of sleep; they're worried about the nights when they get <4 hours of sleep. During all 3 weeks that I did sleep restriction, I averaged less than 5.3 hours of sleep per night, and my sleep became more unpredictable. This app's advice&program increased my sleep anxiety.
